title: Yumimi Mix Remix (Demo)
native_title: ゆみみみっくす リみっくす
overview:
A trial version of Yumimi Mix Remix, an animated adventure from Game Arts drawn in a bright shoujo manga style.

Yumimi Yoshizawa is an ordinary high school girl who spends her days with her childhood friends Sakurako and Shinichi. Then one morning on the way to school she spots something strange in her path, and from then on surreal and extraordinary things keep happening to her and her friends.

Watch the story unfold like an interactive cartoon and make choices that steer it down different branches toward multiple endings. The full game adds animation scenes not seen in the earlier version and a puzzle game that unlocks bonus artwork.
